name: Potere e bellezza
overview: Potere e bellezza (Power and Beauty) is a series of eight historical documentaries, hosted primarily by Spanish historian Igor Santos Salazar and art historian Paolo Cova, or—depending on the dynasty to which each episode is dedicated—by Tomaso Montanari, Walter Barberis, Fulvio Delle Donne, Marco Bellabarba, Antonio Ernesto Denunzio, Federico Barbierato, Francesco Paolo Tocci, and Renata De Lorenzo. Power and Beauty is by Mario Paloschi, written by Andrea Cedrola, and directed by Emanuela Flangini. It is a co-production of Rai Storia and Ballandi Arts.
